Big Signal   Model Layer
San Francisco · Washington DC
GPT-5.6 launches as three-tier family with government gate
OpenAI released GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna — a tiered model family spanning $1–$5 input per million tokens. All three are restricted to ~20 preview partners at the US government's request, with general availability expected…
Implications / For AI PMs
→ Evaluate Terra ($2.50/$15 per 1M tokens) as a GPT-5.5 drop-in at half the cost
→ Build access-contingency plans now — government gating may delay your Sol integration by weeks

OpenAI Jalapeño chip targets 50% inference cost reduction
